blocks.title: Galvanic (voltaic) cell
blocks.text: Galvanic cell woh cell hai jis mein kimiyai energy ka bijli ki energy mein badalna exothermic redox amal mein khud-ba-khud (spontaneously) hota hai, anode par oxidation aur cathode par reduction ke saath. Yeh electrons ki khud-ba-khud muntaqili se faida uthane ke liye banaya jata hai; galvanic cell ko voltaic cell bhi kehte hain, misal ke taur par Daniell cell aur dry cell.

Half-equation Cu2+(aq) + 2e- se Cu(s) ka electrode potential napne ke liye khalis copper rod Cu2+(aq) ions ke solution jaise copper(II) sulfate mein rakhi jati hai; yeh Cu2+/Cu system half-cell hai, standard halaat mein bana hua: Cu2+ 1.00 mol dm-3 par, 25 degrees C (298 K) aur khalis copper rod. Do half-cells jorna electrochemical cell banata hai jis ka voltage napa ja sakta hai. Figure 10.7 Cu2+/Cu half-cell ko Zn2+/Zn half-cell (Zn2+ + 2e- se Zn, -0.76 V) se jura dikhati hai.

Half-cells un taaron se jure hain jo metal rods ko high-resistance voltmeter se milate hain, jis se electrons bairooni circuit mein zyada manfi (kam musbat) electrode potential wale metal se kam manfi (zyada musbat) wale metal ki taraf behte hain; aur salt bridge se, jo do half-cells ke darmiyan ions ki harkat ki ijazat de kar bijli ka circuit mukammal karta hai taake ionic tawazun barqarar rahe, magar electrons ki harkat ki ijazat nahi deta. Salt bridge filter paper (ya kisi aur inert masamdar madde) ki patti ho sakti hai jo saturated potassium nitrate solution mein bhigoi gai ho.

blocks.alt: Baen: do beakers, zinc sulfate mein zinc aur copper sulfate mein copper, narangi salt bridge aur +1.10 V parhte voltmeter wale taaron se jure, sabz teer zinc se copper ki taraf electron flow dikhata hua aur neeche half-equations. Oopar daen: standard cell potential ka usool Cu/Zn, Ag/Zn aur Cu/Fe misalon ke saath. Neeche daen: E standard se feasibility magnesium-silver, iron-silver aur aluminium-silver soorton aur zyada taqatwar oxidising aur reducing agents ke usool ke saath.
blocks.caption: Zn-Cu galvanic cell, standard cell potentials, electron flow ki simt aur feasibility (Figures 10.7 se 10.10 aur topics 10.15 se 10.17.3 aur 10.21 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Zinc, zyada manfi electrode potential ke saath, anode hai aur zinc ions ke taur par halta hai; us ke chhore electrons taar se copper cathode tak jate hain, jahan copper ions reduce ho kar jam jate hain, aur salt bridge ions ko harkat dene deta hai taake koi solution charge jama na kare. Cell ka voltage dono standard potentials ka farq hai, copper aur zinc ke liye 1.10 V, silver aur zinc ke liye 1.56 V. Half-equations ka koi bhi jora isi tarah parkha ja sakta hai: agar zyada musbat half-cell reduction aur zyada manfi oxidation likha jaye to cell potential musbat aur reaction mumkin hai, is liye magnesium silver ions ko reduce karta hai magar silver magnesium ya aluminium ions ko nahi.

blocks.text: Half-equations Cu2+(aq) + 2e- se Cu(s), E standard = +0.34 V, aur Zn2+(aq) + 2e- se Zn(s), E standard = -0.76 V hain. Nisbati qeematein dikhati hain ke Zn2+ ions Cu2+ ions se mushkil se reduce hote hain, aur cell ka voltage +1.10 V hai: E cell = E(reduction) - E(oxidation) = +0.34 - (-0.76) = +1.10 V. Cu-Zn galvanic cell mein zinc anode aur solution ke copper ions cathode hain: anode par zinc oxidise hota hai, Zn(s) se Zn2+(aq) + 2e-; electrons bairooni circuit se cathode tak jate hain, jahan copper ions reduce hote hain, Cu2+(aq) + 2e- se Cu(s); kul cell reaction Zn(s) + Cu2+(aq) se Zn2+(aq) + Cu(s) hai. Redox reaction ki kimiyai energy bijli ki energy mein badal jati hai jo kaam kar sakti hai.

blocks.prompt: Salt bridge ke kaam aur faide kya hain, aur use hatane par voltage ko kya hota hai (Quick Check 10.7i; exercise Q.2c; MCQ VII)?
blocks.explanation: Salt bridge half-cells ke darmiyan ions ko muntaqil hone de kar circuit mukammal karta hai, to zinc solution musbat charge aur copper solution manfi charge jama nahi karta, jabke dono solutions seedhe milne se bache rehte hain. Is ke baghair charge foran jama hota hai, electron flow ruk jata hai aur voltage sifar ho jata hai.

items: Galvanic (voltaic) cell: khud-ba-khud exothermic redox bijli ki energy deta hai; anode par oxidation, cathode par reduction (Daniell cell, dry cell).
Cu-Zn cell: Zn anode (-), Cu cathode (+), electrons taar se Zn se Cu, salt bridge (filter paper par KNO3) ions le jata hai; E cell = +0.34 - (-0.76) = +1.10 V; Zn + Cu2+ se Zn2+ + Cu.
